    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", 0)

    # ---- Helpers ----
    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for v in route:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    def feasible_concat(a, b, orientation):
        # orientation: 0 means a + b, 1 means a + reversed(b)
        la = route_load(a)
        lb = route_load(b)
        if la + lb > capacity:
            return None
        if orientation == 0:
            return a + b
        else:
            return a + b[::-1]

        n = len(route)

            return route
        best = route_cost(route)

                        route = nr
                        n = len(route)

                        improved = True

        return route

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    nearest_neighbors = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", {})
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", 0)

    # ---- Helpers ----
    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for v in route:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    def feasible_concat(a, b, orientation):
        # orientation: 0 means a + b, 1 means a + reversed(b)
        la = route_load(a)
        lb = route_load(b)
        if la + lb > capacity:
            return None
        if orientation == 0:
            return a + b
        else:
            return a + b[::-1]

    def two_opt_intra(route):
        # First-improvement deterministic
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        best = route_cost(route)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            # indices i<k, reverse segment (i..k)
            for i in range(0, n - 3):
                a = route[i - 1] if i > 0 else depot
                b = route[i]
                for k in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                    c = route[k]
                    d = route[k + 1] if k + 1 < n else depot
                    old = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < old:
                        # apply reversal
                        nr = route[:i] + route[i:k + 1][::-1] + route[k + 1:]
                        route = nr
                        n = len(route)
                        best = best - old + new
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

    def improve_inter_relocate(routes, max_passes=2):
        # Deterministic best-improvement limited passes
        # Try moving a single node i from route r1 to route r2 (any position)
        passes = 0
        while passes < max_passes:
            passes += 1
            best_delta = 0
            best_move = None  # (ri, i_pos, rj, insert_pos, new_route_i, new_route_j)
            for ri in range(len(routes)):
                r1 = routes[ri]
                if not r1:
                    continue
                for i_pos in range(len(r1)):
                    v = r1[i_pos]
